question.problem:
| $x$ | **$-8$** | **$-6$** | **$-4$** | **$-2$** | **$0$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-5$ | $-1$ | $4$ | $7$ | $11$ |

The vector of coefficients  of the line $y={\beta }_{0}+{\beta }_{1}x$ that best fits the data above can be found using linear regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the observation vector $y$ in this context?
question.worked_solution:
| $x$ | **$-8$** | **$-6$** | **$-4$** | **$-2$** | **$0$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-5$ | $-1$ | $4$ | $7$ | $11$ |

The coefficients of the line that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}1 & -8 \\ 1 & -6 \\ 1 & -4 \\ 1 & -2 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{0} \\ {\beta }_{1}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -1 \\ 4 \\ 7 \\ 11\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
